title: KL Divergence
interviewAnswer: KL divergence measures how poorly distribution Q approximates P. It is non-negative but asymmetric, so it is not a distance metric.
why: KL appears in VAEs, variational inference, distillation and policy optimization.
intuition: Think of P as what you care about and Q as your approximation; KL penalizes Q where it fails to represent probability mass used by P.
deepDive: D_KL(P||Q)=E_P[log P-log Q]. Forward and reverse directions produce different approximation behavior, especially for multimodal distributions.
commonMistakes: Treating KL as bounded between 0 and 1.
followUps: Why does KL appear in VAEs?
production: Check support and numerical smoothing because zero probabilities can create infinite/unstable values.
workedExample: Approximating a bimodal target with one Gaussian can cover modes or concentrate on one depending on KL direction.
